title: Kissed Russian Pepper Pilaf
description: A spicy and comforting Russian dish made with crumbled peppered cheese and a tangy glaze, without any onions or garlic.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly, until it forms a light brown paste.
Slowly whisk in the beef broth and water, and cook for 2 minutes, until the mixture thickens.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, until it reduces slightly.
Stir in the crumbled cheese, sour cream, dried dill, salt, and black pepper until the cheese is fully incorporated.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the sugar and lemon juice until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the Kissed Russian Pepper Pilaf warm, garnished with additional crumbled cheese and a sprinkle of cracked black pepper if desired.
This recipe makes 4-6 servings and can be prepared in about 30 minutes.
You can also make this recipe ahead of time and refrigerate it for up to 24 hours before serving, then reheat it in the oven at 350°F for 15-20 minutes, until warmed through.
